article.title: 工具補讀：Meigen AI提示詞庫加入17個影片範例
article.title_en: Creative reference: Meigen AI adds 17 video prompt examples
article.summary: 更新日誌列出20個新增項目，當中17個是影片提示詞，另有3個圖片提示詞。
article.summary_en: The changelog lists 20 new entries, including 17 video prompts and three image prompts.
highlights: 新增範例涵蓋時裝分鏡、微型食物與光線變化。
平台表示保留來源貼文的創作者標註。
highlights_en: Examples cover fashion panels, miniature food and lighting changes.
Meigen says it retains original creator attribution.
article.why: 創意團隊可用範例比較不同鏡頭指令如何寫入簡報，並建立自己的指令結構。
article.why_en: Creative teams can compare how shot instructions are written and build their own brief structure.
article.next_step: 挑一個構圖例子，保留鏡頭和光線描述，換成品牌有權使用的參考素材。
article.next_step_en: Pick one composition and apply its camera and lighting structure to brand-authorised references.
article.detail: 這次是提示詞庫新增內容。團隊可拆開觀察主體、鏡頭、光線與動作如何描述，再用自家素材重寫其中一段。公開貼文與作者標註可協助追溯來源，商用前仍應確認素材與示例輸出的使用條件。即使採用相同的指令結構，也宜保存生成版本及修改紀錄，方便與同事比較結果。
article.detail_en: The update adds library entries. Study subject, camera, lighting and movement separately, then rewrite a prompt for your own material. Public attribution helps trace the source. Check usage terms before commercial use and retain generation and revision records for team comparison.
